_comment: What ground that gives way under itself costs an Age's instability budget, and how far it can reach
Difficulty you can answer: what it asks of a player is to read the floor, and three seconds of
unmistakable fracture is a long time to get off a piece of ground. A step buys size and speed -- how
much ground one collapse takes, and how fast it goes once the warning is over -- which want splitting
into dials of their own. It never buys the warning: a collapse that arrived unannounced would not be a
harder version of this, it would be a different and worse thing.
Not the same register as `collapse`, which tears the world floor and ends the Age. This one only ever
takes the hillside you are standing on. Opens at 16 with the other phenomena.
